newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India may award Nov fuel oil to FAL Energy - traders.
newsitem.headline: India may award Nov fuel oil to FAL Energy - traders.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) is likely to award its tender to buy 25,000 tonnes of fuel oil for November 6-10 delivery to MidEast bunker trader FAL Energy, industry sources said on Monday.

They said FAL Energy has submitted the lowest offer of around $13.50 per tonne premium to MidEast spot quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis or $6.00 per tonne premium to MidEast quotes on a free-on-board basis. The tender calls for 180-centistike grade, 3.5-percent sulphur fuel oil.
This tender closed on October 24 and is IOC is expected to be awarded later on Monday, they said.
The cargo is to be delivered to Bombay on the Indian west coast.

IOC has issued two other tenders in November to buy an additional 25,000 tonnes for November 16-20 delivery to Bombay/ Kandla and 14,000 tonnes for November 15-18 delivery to Mangalore/Bombay on the west coast.
Both tenders will close on October 31 and are valid until November 1.
